//Compile MCC_CONFIG_OPTIMIZER=1 into the cross compilers (mcc-<arch>).
// ON (default) makes the cross reemit/JIT parity axes (divmagic/select/promotion/replay-inline/embed-jit)
// real on every triple, matching native; also appends MCC_EMBED_JIT=1.
// OFF builds the cross compilers without the AST reemit optimizer
// (smaller/faster cross build, byte-identical to the pre-ungate
// cross output) but leaves those per-triple parity axes compiled
// out so they silently no-op.
MCC_CROSS_OPTIMIZER:BOOL=ON

//Subset of cross triples to build under MCC_ENABLE_CROSS, comma-
// or semicolon-separated (e.g. x86_64-osx,arm64-osx). Empty (default)
// builds every triple. Each entry must name one of: i386 x86_64
// i386-win32 x86_64-win32 x86_64-osx arm arm64 arm64-win32 arm-win32
// arm-wince riscv64 arm64-osx. Narrowing it lets a CI cell build
// only the object-format compilers its validators need instead
// of all twelve.
MCC_CROSS_TARGETS:STRING=

//Extra diff3 reference compilers as a ;-list of label=path; each
// must accept a gcc-style '-o' build line and run its output natively
// on the host. Widens the N-way majority consensus (use independent
// compiler families, not a second build of one already listed
// -- the runner de-dups identical --version but cannot tell two
// gcc builds apart, and double-weighting one family skews the
// vote).

//Link the §26 Tier-B runtime-JIT engine slice + intention serializer/recompile

//Build libmcc from a single TU (Makefile: MCC_AMALGAMATED)

//Internal: set on matrix child cells to suppress superbuild recursion
MCC_SUPERBUILD_CHILD:BOOL=OFF

//Build toolchain stages in order (targets within a stage stay
// parallel)
MCC_SUPERBUILD_SEQUENTIAL:BOOL=ON

//Run ctest after each matrix sub-build
MCC_SUPERBUILD_TEST:BOOL=ON

//configure --sysroot
MCC_SYSROOT:STRING=

//Cross-platform target(s) to build, as a list (native;cross;<custom>)
MCC_TARGETS:STRING=native

//Toolchain(s) to build with, in order (list, e.g. gcc;clang;mcc);
// single = profile+defaults
MCC_TOOLCHAIN_PROFILE:STRING=auto

//configure --triplet
MCC_TRIPLET:STRING=

//Root directory for downloaded/vendored toolchains and externals
// (gcc/clang/mingw/musl)
MCC_VENDOR_DIR:PATH=/home/llg/Projects/mcc/vendor

//Path to a program.
MCC_VENDOR_GCC:FILEPATH=MCC_VENDOR_GCC-NOTFOUND

//Path to a file.
MCC_X11_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/usr/include

//Value Computed by CMake
mcc_BINARY_DIR:STATIC=/home/llg/Projects/mcc/b

//Value Computed by CMake
mcc_IS_TOP_LEVEL:STATIC=ON

//Value Computed by CMake
mcc_SOURCE_DIR:STATIC=/home/llg/Projects/mcc
